Olga / team,

Notes from infra:
- Peering: we recommend direct VPC peering for single-region deployments; for multi-region or if they want central connectivity, recommend AWS Transit Gateway. We'll include both options and pros/cons.
- CIDR: require 172.30.0.0/16 for Redwood-managed VPCs by default; peerable ranges must not overlap. For customer side we ask for a /16 block and we will provide /24 allocations for each worker pool during onboarding.
- Provisioning lead time: standard peering provisioning is 5 business days; dedicated window (expedited) ~2 business days if we have pre-approved configs and an SLA addendum.
- KMS: we support BYOK with HSM; recommend separate key rings per customer for strict separation. For SOC 2 reviewers, call out that keys are rotated per policy and access is audited.

Attachments: vpc_peering_playbook.pdf (stub) — includes sample Terraform snippets and peering checklist.

I can add a short sample CIDR table to the checklist.

—Priyom

Redwood Inference

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the quick turnaround—please find the artifacts attached:

1) Redwood jurisdiction statement (PDF) — concise paragraph that affirms Redwood Private can be configured for US-only hosting for customer workloads and metadata, plus a short bullet list of controls we map to SOC 2 / CAIQ (encryption at-rest/in-transit, access control, audit logging).

2) Private deployment onboarding checklist (DOCX) — networking table (peer options + CIDR recommendations), KMS options (BYOK / HSM guidance), contact and escalation matrix for onboarding, and expected provisioning windows (standard 5 business days / expedited 2 business days).

3) VPC peering playbook (PDF) — sample Terraform, CIDR examples, peering checklist.

Key points:
- Region: US-only can be guaranteed when provisioning a Redwood Private tenant scoped to a single US region (we will document the region in the onboarding agreement).
- KMS: we can support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) with HSM, and we recommend separate key rings per customer to support cryptographic separation for audits.
- Logs & evidence: SOC 2 controls around key access and audit trails are available; we can provide filtered logs for the onboarding period and a SOC 2 summary reference on request.

Next steps:
- If this looks good, sign the attached checklist acceptance and we will open a JIRA EPIC to start provisioning. If you prefer, I can send the checklist via DocuSign for signatures: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-deploy-onboard
- Technical onboarding lead: Priyom Das (priyom.das@redwood.ai) — he will coordinate peering.
- Ops escalation: Grace O'Connor (grace.oconnor@redwood.ai) — 24/7 on-call escalation if needed.

Attachments included: redwood_jurisdiction_statement_v1.pdf, private_deploy_onboarding_checklist_v3.docx, vpc_peering_playbook.pdf

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
